bilingualReadings.title: Nkima
bilingualReadings.text:
Ng'ura, nkima!

Kepejisho nkima.

Keyerisho nkima.

Keysheru nkima nkirewaj.

Keysheru nkima ong'an.

Ng'ura, nkima!

Kesupat oleng' nkima.

Naa keata ngupu.
bilingualReadings.english:
Look, fire!

Fire burns.

Fire cooks.

Fire gives warmth.

Fire gives light.

Look, fire!

Fire is wonderful.

And it is powerful.
